Replaced with a Sec. 704-grounded question on protected exterior-wall opening percentage per storey.

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 704

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704, when an exterior wall opening requires protection, what is the maximum percentage of the total wall area in any storey that may be occupied by protected openings?

options.text: 25 percent of the wall area in that storey
33 percent of the wall area in that storey
50 percent of the wall area in that storey
75 percent of the wall area in that storey

proposed.rationale: Section 704 limits the sum of protected openings in an exterior wall in any storey to a maximum of 50 percent of the total wall area in that storey. The wall-area basis is per storey, not the whole building.
proposed.explanation: The 50 percent limit applies only to protected openings and only when the other location and fire-resistance conditions are satisfied. It is not a blanket permission to open any wall.
